blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Autonomous agents have made rapid progress in general-purpose computer use, but reliable automation of professional industrial engineering remains out of reach, as engineering workflows demand reasoning over geometric and physical constraints and dependencies preserved across software and design stages. We present EngiWorld , the first benchmark structured around the complete design loop: 1,301 expert-curated tasks spanning 6 engineering domains (CAD, CAE, CAM, BIM, EDA, and 3D visualization) and 26 professional software platforms, with both GUI and CLI interfaces and 6 task types ranging from software-selection to open-ended tasks. We further introduce an artifact-centric evaluation methodology built on a unified domain-verifier suite, which programmatically checks the geometric validity, physical feasibility, and rule compliance of final and intermediate artifacts, and scores quantitative design tasks continuously by specification attainment rather than binary success. Evaluation of seven frontier models reveals a substantial capability gap: the strongest model achieves an EngiScore of only 44.3, and just 3.6% of multi-software attempts succeed. EngiWorld provides the first rigorous foundation for measuring progress toward agents that operate professional engineering software end to end.
blocks.zh: 自主代理在通用计算机使用方面迅速取得进展,但专业工业工程的可靠自动化仍然遥不可及,因为工程工作流程需要推理,而不是几何学和物理限制以及软件和设计阶段保存的依赖性. EngiWorld是第一个围绕整个设计循环构建的基准:1,301项专家确定的任务,涉及6个工程领域(CAD、CAE、CAM、BIM、EDA和3D可视化)和26个专业软件平台,有GUI和CLI两个接口和6个任务类型,从软件选择到开放式任务。 我们进一步采用了以人工为中心的评价方法,该方法建立在统一的域-验证器套件上,在方案上检查几何有效性、物理可行性以及最终和中间文物的合规性,并通过规格的实现而不是二进制的成功来不断对定量设计任务进行评分。 对七个前沿模型的评价揭示了一个巨大的能力差距:最强的模型只实现了44.3的Engiscore,只有3.6%的多软件尝试成功. EngiWorld为衡量在运行专业工程软件结束的代理商方面的进展提供了第一个严格的基础.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs), multimodal large language models (MLLMs), and agents built on them have achieved transformative progress on general computer-use tasks, and can now plan, perceive, and act across digital environments spanning web navigation, office productivity, and software engineering Deng et al. (2023) ; Zhou et al. (2023) ; Xie et al. (2024) ; Rawles et al. (2024) ; Kapoor et al. (2024) ; Jimenez et al. (2023) ; Yang et al. (2023) ; Huang et al. (2024) ; Lai et al. (2023) . However, their potential in professional industrial design software, a domain of enormous economic and societal value, remains largely unexplored Ren et al. (2025) ; Gao et al. (2025) ; Liu et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs),多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)及其基础上的代理人在一般计算机使用任务上取得了变革性的进展,现在可以规划,感知,并跨越跨越跨越网络导航,办公生产率和软件工程邓等人(2023年);周等人(2023年);谢等人(2024年);罗尔斯等人(2024年);卡普尔等人(2024年);希门尼斯等人(2023年);杨等人(2023年);黄等人(2024年);莱等人(2023年). 然而,它们在具有巨大经济和社会价值的专业工业设计软件领域的潜力,基本上仍未得到探讨。

blocks.zh: 图1:恩吉世界概览 该基准涵盖26个软件平台和涵盖6个工程领域的Workbenches,包括6个任务类型,共同构成对完整设计环的评价.

blocks.en:
Although existing benchmarks have succeeded in evaluating general digital workflows, they expose significant limitations when applied to industrial domains.
First, benchmarks such as OSWorld ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , Spider2-V ( Cao et al., 2024 ) , and ScienceBoard ( Sun et al., 2026a ) determine success by comparing final states or reference solutions, which cannot verify the functional integrity of engineering artifacts: a visually “correct” model may be unusable due to non-manifold geometry, improper topological constraints, or violations of physical laws Wu et al. (2021) ; Jayaraman et al. (2021) ; Li et al. (2022) ; although FEABench ( Mudur et al., 2025 ) , BIM-Edit ( Nithyanantham et al., 2026 ) , and CADTestBench ( Mallis et al., 2026 ) have begun to validate artifact quality, each is confined to a single software platform and a single task format.
Second, existing work lacks sufficient interaction depth: Text2CAD ( Khan et al., 2024 ) is dominated by single-turn generation, and although CADWorld ( Dong et al., 2026 ) introduces GUI interaction, its step budget is capped at only one hundred steps, whereas industrial tasks require maintaining parametric logic over long operation sequences, where an early error can invalidate all subsequent operations Man et al. (2025) ; Gong et al. (2026) .
Finally, current frameworks suffer from a significant feedback gap : agents receive only textual signals (e.g., compilation errors) ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Yue et al., 2025 ) , and GUI-EDA ( Li et al., 2025 ) even resorts to offline single-step prediction without executing any action, whereas engineers rely on native feedback from domain tools, such as rendered outputs, simulation convergence curves, and design-rule violation reports, to iteratively refine their designs.
However, real engineering work is a complete design loop , yet each of these benchmarks covers only one link of it.
blocks.zh:
虽然现有基准成功地评价了一般数字工作流程,但它们在适用于工业领域时暴露了重大的局限性。
首先,OSWorld(Xie等人,2024年),Spider2-V(Cao等人,2024年)和ScienceBoard(Sun等人,2026年a)等基准通过比较最终状态或参考解决方案来确定成功与否,这些最终状态或参考解决方案无法验证工程文物的功能完整性:视觉上的“正确”模型可能由于非磁性几何学,不适当的地形限制,或违反物理规律的Wu等人(2021年);Jayaraman等人(2021年);Li等人(2022年);虽然FEA Bench(Mudur等人,2025年),BIM-Edit(Nithyanantham等人,2026年),以及CADTest Bench(Mallis等人,2026年)已经开始验证文物质量,但每个模型都局限于单一的软件平台和单一的任务格式。
第二,现有工作缺乏足够的互动深度:Text2CAD(Khan等人,2024年)以单回合生成为主,虽然CADWorld(Dong等人,2026年)引入了GUI互动,但其步数预算只上限为一百步,而工业任务则需要保持长运行序列的参数逻辑,在长运行序列上,早期误差可以使所有后续操作失效Man等人(2025年);龚等人(2026年).
最后,当前的框架存在重大的反馈差距:代理只接收文字信号(例如汇编错误)(Wu等人,2024年;Yue等人,2025年),以及GUI-EDA(Li等人,2025年)甚至采用离线单步预测,而不执行任何行动,而工程师则依赖域工具的本土反馈,如输出、模拟趋同曲线和设计规则违规报告,以迭代完善其设计。
然而,真正的工程工作是一个完整的设计循环,然而,每个基准只涵盖其中的一个环节。

blocks.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce EngiWorld , the first benchmark structured around the complete design loop for evaluating agents in professional industrial design environments. As shown in Figure 1 , EngiWorld spans six engineering domains (CAD, CAE, CAM, BIM, EDA, and 3D visualization), covering 26 software platforms and workbenches with 1,301 expert-curated tasks; the tasks are grounded in real engineering processes ( Gao et al., 2025 ) and require agents to interact with real professional software over multiple turns through GUI or CLI interfaces, maintaining parametric logic across long sequences of operations and applications ( Man et al., 2025 ; Gong et al., 2026 ) . Six task types each evaluate one dimension of the engineering capability stack: image-based modeling , software selection , single-software and long-horizon execution , quantitative design , multi-software coordination , and open-ended tasks that provide only the requirements and a blank computer, together covering all stages of the design process (Figure 3 ).
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了EngiWorld,这是第一个围绕专业工业设计环境中评估代理商的完整设计循环而构建的基准。 如图1所示,EngiWorld跨越6个工程领域(CAD、CAE、CAM、BIM、EDA和3D可视化),涵盖26个软件平台和工作台,承担1 301项专家确定的任务;这些任务以真正的工程流程为基础(Gao等人,2025年),要求代理商通过GUI或CLI接口在多个转弯上与真正的专业软件进行互动,在操作和应用的长序上保持参数逻辑(Man等人,2025年;Gong等人,2026年)。 6个任务类型各自评价工程能力堆栈的一个维度:基于图像的建模,软件选择,单软件和长范围执行,定量设计,多软件协调,以及仅提供要求和一个空白计算机的开放式任务,共同覆盖设计过程的所有阶段(图3).

blocks.en: Furthermore, we propose an artifact-centric evaluation methodology . To address the open and non-unique nature of industrial artifacts, we extend artifact-level programmatic verification from single-domain precedents ( Mudur et al., 2025 ; Nithyanantham et al., 2026 ; Mallis et al., 2026 ; Singh et al., 2026 ) into a unified domain-verifier suite spanning all six domains, which checks the geometric accuracy, physical feasibility, and rule compliance of both final and intermediate artifacts (e.g., STEP files, netlists, and G-code) ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Yue et al., 2025 ) ; unlike the binary judgments of existing benchmarks, quantitative design tasks are gated by feasibility checks and report continuous quality scores according to the degree of specification attainment, evaluating how well a task is completed rather than merely whether it is completed.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们提议采用以文物为中心的评价方法。 为了解决工业文物的开放性和非独特性问题,我们从单一领域先例(Mudur等人,2025年;Nithyanantham等人,2026年;Mallis等人,2026年;Singh等人,2026年)中将文物一级的方案核查扩大到一个覆盖所有六个领域的统一的域-核查套房,该套房将检查几何精确度、物理可行性,以及最终和中间文物(例如STEP文件、网络清单和G-code)的合规性(Wu等人,2024年;Yue等人,2025年);与现有基准的二进制判断不同,定量设计任务以可行性检查为中心,并根据规格的完成程度报告连续的质量分数,评价一项任务是如何完成的,而不仅仅是是否完成。

blocks.en: We extensively evaluate seven state-of-the-art agents, covering three proprietary models and four open-source models. The results show that even frontier models fall significantly short of industrial-grade engineering standards. Diagnostic analysis reveals failure modes across every stage of the design loop: agents struggle to coordinate cross-application dependencies, satisfy precise geometric and physical constraints, and verify deliverables before completion, and they frequently overlook critical feedback such as solver residuals. These findings highlight the profound gap between general intelligence and the demands of professional engineering, positioning EngiWorld as a rigorous foundation for future research on industrial agents.
blocks.zh: 我们广泛评价7个最先进的代理商,涵盖3个专有模型和4个开源模型. 结果显示,即使是前沿模型也大大低于工业级工程标准. 诊断分析揭示了设计循环各个阶段的失败模式:代理商在协调跨应用依赖性,满足精确的几何和物理限制,并在完成前核实可交付成果方面挣扎不已,它们经常忽略解析器残存等关键反馈. 这些发现凸显了一般智能与专业工程需求之间的深刻差距,将恩吉世界定位为未来研究工业剂的坚实基础.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Computer-Use Benchmarks. Benchmarks for autonomous agents cover software engineering ( Jimenez et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) , web interaction ( Deng et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2023 ; Koh et al., 2024 ) , and desktop operation ( Xie et al., 2024 ) . OSWorld evaluates task completion in real desktop environments, while Spider2-V ( Cao et al., 2024 ) and ScienceBoard ( Sun et al., 2026a ) extend evaluation to professional data-engineering and scientific workflows. These settings combine interaction through graphical or command-line interfaces with execution-based outcome checks. More recent benchmarks examine long-horizon execution and workflow dependencies: OSWorld2 ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) studies extended computer-use tasks, and Agents’ Last Exam (ALE) ( Sun et al., 2026b ) evaluates professional workflows with verifiable deliverables across industries, including engineering and 3D applications.
blocks.zh: 计算机使用基准。 自主代理的基准涵盖软件工程(Jimenez等人,2023年;Yang等人,2023年;Huang等人,2024年),网络互动 (Deng等人,2023年;Zhou等人,2023年;Koh等人,2024年),以及桌面操作(Xie等人,2024年). OSWorld在真实的桌面环境中评价任务完成情况,而Spider2-V(Cao等人,2024年)和ScienceBoard(Sun等人,2026a年)则将评价扩展到专业的数据工程和科学工作流程. 这些设置通过图形或命令行界面将互动与基于执行的结果检查结合起来. 更近期的基准审查长距离执行和工作流程依赖性:OSWorld2(袁等人,2026年)研究延长的计算机使用任务,Agents ' Last Exam(ALE)(Sun等人,2026年b)评价跨行业可核查可交付成果的专业工作流程,包括工程和3D应用.

Engineering Agents and Benchmarks. Engineering automation encompasses both structured artifact generation and interactive software use. DeepCAD ( Wu et al., 2021 ) and Text2CAD ( Khan et al., 2024 ) generate parametric CAD construction sequences, while RTLCoder ( Liu et al., 2024 ) generates hardware descriptions. VerilogEval ( Liu et al., 2023 ) assesses functional correctness through simulation, and RTLLM ( Lu et al., 2024 ) additionally evaluates power, performance, and area objectives. Tool-using approaches incorporate planning and execution feedback into CAD modeling, electronic design, and numerical simulation ( Gong et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Yue et al., 2025 ) .
VideoCAD ( Man et al., 2025 ) and GUI-EDA ( Li et al., 2025 ) provide datasets for learning and evaluating professional GUI interactions and action prediction.
blocks.zh:
工程代理和基准。 工程自动化既包括结构化的工艺品生成,也包括交互式软件的使用. DeepCAD(Wu等人,2021年)和Text2CAD(Khan等人,2024年)生成参数CAD构建序列,而RTLCoder(Liu等人,2024年)生成硬件描述. 维利洛格 Eval(Liu等人,2023年)通过模拟评估功能正确性,RTLLM(Lu等人,2024年)额外评价功率,性能,以及地区目标. 工具使用方法将规划和执行反馈纳入CAD模型、电子设计和数字模拟(Gong等人,2026年;Wu等人,2024年;Chen等人,2024年;Yue等人,2025年)。
VideoCAD(Man等人,2025年)和GUI-EDA(Li等人,2025年)为学习和评价专业GUI互动和行动预测提供了数据集.

blocks.en: Engineering benchmarks also assess whether generated artifacts satisfy domain-specific requirements. CADWorld ( Dong et al., 2026 ) evaluates GUI-based FreeCAD workflows spanning modeling, simulation, and manufacturing. CADTestBench ( Mallis et al., 2026 ) uses executable tests to check geometric and topological requirements, while CADEngBench ( Singh et al., 2026 ) examines engineering-oriented CAD capabilities. Beyond CAD, FEABench ( Mudur et al., 2025 ) evaluates multiphysics problem solving in COMSOL, BIM-Edit ( Nithyanantham et al., 2026 ) assesses IFC model edits through geometric, semantic, and topological criteria, and BlenderGym ( Gu et al., 2025 ) evaluates graphics editing through start–goal scene pairs. Across these benchmarks, evaluation ranges from functional simulation and executable constraint checks to geometric and visual comparisons, reflecting the different requirements of engineering artifacts.
blocks.zh: 工程基准还评估生成的文物是否符合特定领域的要求。 CADWorld(Dong等人,2026年)评价基于GUI的FreeCAD工作流程,涵盖建模,模拟和制造. CADTest Bench(Mallis等人,2026年)使用可执行测试来检查几何和地形要求,而CADENG Bench(Singh等人,2026年)则研究面向工程的CAD能力. 除了CAD之外,FEA Bench(Mudur等人,2025年)评价了在COMSOL,BIM-Edit(Nithyanantham等人,2026年)中解决多物理问题的方法,评价了IFC模型通过几何,语义和地形标准进行编辑,BlenderGym(Gu等人,2025年)评价了图形通过起始-目标场景对等进行编辑. 在这些基准中,评价范围从功能模拟和可执行制约检查到几何和视觉比较,反映了工程文物的不同要求。

blocks.en: 3 The EngiWorld Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3. 恩吉世界基准

blocks.en: In this section, we describe the task formulation and interaction model (Section 3.1 ), the software environments and interaction interfaces (Section 3.2 ), the task construction pipeline and benchmark coverage (Section 3.3 ), and the artifact-centric evaluation protocol (Section 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们叙述任务拟订和互动模式(第3.1节)、软件环境和互动接口(第3.2节)、任务构建管道和基准覆盖范围(第3.3节)以及以文物为中心的评价协议(第3.4节)。

blocks.en: 3.1 Benchmark Overview and Task Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 基准概述和任务制定

blocks.en: An EngiWorld task places an agent in a native engineering software environment and asks it to produce or modify engineering artifacts under a task specification. A specification may include a natural-language objective, reference media, initial project files, and required intermediate or final deliverables. We represent each task as τ i = ( g i , x i , e i , 𝒜 i , Y i , C i ) , \tau_{i}=(g_{i},x_{i},e_{i},\mathcal{A}_{i},Y_{i},C_{i}), where g i g_{i} is the task objective, x i x_{i} contains task inputs such as reference media and initial files, e i e_{i} specifies the software environment and workspace state, 𝒜 i \mathcal{A}_{i} is the set of available interface actions, Y i Y_{i} defines the required deliverables, and C i C_{i} contains the acceptance criteria. The formulation mirrors the stages of the design loop introduced in Section 1 : x i x_{i} and e i e_{i} specify how intent and environment are presented to the agent, 𝒜 i \mathcal{A}_{i} governs construction, and Y i Y_{i} together with C i C_{i} encodes specification and delivery. GUI observations consist primarily of rendered application states and may include accessibility information, whereas CLI observations consist of terminal outputs, file contents, and execution logs. blocks.en: 3.2 Environments and Interaction
blocks.zh: 3.2 环境与互动

blocks.en: EngiWorld tasks run in isolated Windows or Ubuntu environments containing the required native engineering applications. Each episode starts from a task-specific workspace state with the necessary input files and application documents prepared. Single-software tasks use a designated application, whereas Multi-software tasks provide a shared workspace in which intermediate artifacts are transferred across applications and checked at subsequent stages. Software-selection tasks allow the agent to choose from a permitted set of applications under task-defined interface constraints.
blocks.zh: EngiWorld任务运行在孤立的Windows或Ubuntu环境中,包含所需的本土工程应用. 每集从任务特定的工作空间状态开始,并配有必要的输入文件和应用文件. 单件软件任务使用指定的应用软件,而多件软件任务则提供共享的工作空间,中间的文物在应用软件之间传输,并在后续阶段检查. 软件选择任务允许代理在任务定义的接口限制下从允许的一组应用程序中选择.

blocks.en: The benchmark supports two interaction interfaces. With the GUI interface, agents operate applications through visual observations and mouse or keyboard actions. With the CLI interface, agents use terminal commands and scripts and receive textual feedback from the software and operating system. The two interfaces expose different observation and action spaces but share the same artifact-based evaluation protocol, so performance is determined by the validity of the resulting engineering deliverables rather than by the interaction modality.
blocks.zh: 基准支持两个交互界面. 使用GUI接口,代理通过视觉观察和鼠标或键盘动作操作应用程序. 通过CLI接口,代理商使用终端命令和脚本,并接收软件和操作系统的文字反馈. 这两个接口暴露了不同的观测和行动空间,但共享相同的基于工艺品的评价协议,因此性能由由此产生的工程交付品的有效性决定,而不是由互动模式决定.

blocks.en: We construct EngiWorld through an expert-calibrated, LLM-assisted pipeline. Domain experts identify representative workflows from software documentation, tutorials, and other engineering resources, and convert them into executable task specifications with task instructions, initial files, reference artifacts, required deliverables, and task-specific verifiers. Experts review sampled specifications and executions for correctness, completeness, ambiguity, and evaluability. Every final task is then executed and reviewed in its designated software environment. Detailed construction and validation procedures are provided in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 我们通过经专家校准的LLM辅助管道建造了EngiWorld。 域专家从软件文档,教程等工程资源中确定具有代表性的工作流程,并将其转化为可执行的任务规范,并附有任务说明,初始文档,参考文物,所需可交付品,以及任务特定核查人. 专家们对规格和处决进行抽样审查,以确定其准确性、完整性、模糊性和可评价性。 然后在其指定的软件环境中执行和审查每一项最终任务。 附录A提供了详细的施工和验证程序。

blocks.en: EngiWorld contains 1,301 task instances across six engineering domains and 26 software platforms and workbenches. The benchmark includes 691 tasks using the CLI interface and 610 tasks using the GUI interface (Figure 3(b) ). Because a workflow may involve multiple applications, software coverage is reported using task–software associations in addition to task instances. The benchmark contains 1,723 associations, where each association represents one software involved in a task. Multi-software tasks therefore contribute one association for each participating application, while Software-selection tasks include all permitted candidate applications. This convention captures the breadth of the engineering ecosystem covered by EngiWorld , spanning geometric models, simulation fields, circuit schematics, building models, and 3D scenes (Figure 3(a) ).
blocks.zh: EngiWorld包含涉及6个工程领域的1,301个任务实例以及26个软件平台和工作台. 基准包括使用CLI接口的691项任务和使用GUI接口的610项任务(图3(b). 由于工作流程可能涉及多个应用程序,因此除了任务实例外,还使用任务软件协会报告软件覆盖范围。 基准包括1 723个协会,每个协会代表一个软件参与一项任务。 因此,多软件任务为每个参与的应用程序贡献一个协会,而软件选择任务包括所有允许的候选应用程序. 这一公约涵盖EngiWorld覆盖的工程生态系统的广度,包括几何模型、模拟场、电路示意图、建筑模型和3D场景(图3(a))。

blocks.en: The six task types form a disjoint partition of the benchmark. Single-software tasks (931) require agents to complete an objective within a designated application. Multi-software tasks (60) require intermediate artifacts to be transferred and preserved across multiple applications. Software-selection tasks (140) allow agents to choose from a permitted set of tools. Quantitative design tasks (40) evaluate both engineering feasibility and a task-specific design objective. Image-based modeling tasks (120) require agents to construct artifacts from visual references. Open-ended tasks (10) remove predefined software and workflow constraints, allowing agents to select the tools and execution strategies. Together, the six types instantiate successive stages of the design loop: image-based modeling probes intent grounding, software-selection probes tool selection, single-software tasks probe precise construction, quantitative design probes specification attainment, multi-software tasks probe cross-toolchain delivery, and open-ended tasks require agents to bootstrap the environment itself.
blocks.zh: 六个任务类型构成了基准的脱节分割. 单软件任务(931)要求代理在指定的应用程序内完成一个目标. 多软件任务(60)要求中间文物在多个应用中进行转移和保存. 软件选择任务(140)允许代理从一组允许的工具中选择. 定量设计任务(40)既评价工程可行性,又评价特定任务的设计目标. 基于图像的建模任务(120)要求代理从视觉参考物中构造文物. 不限成员名额的任务(10)消除预先定义的软件和工作流程限制,使代理商可以选择工具和执行策略. 6种类型共同将设计循环的相继阶段即时化:基于图像的模型探测器意图搁浅,软件选择探测器工具选择,单软件任务探测精确构造,定量设计探测器规格的实现,多软件任务探测器跨工具链的交付,以及开放式任务要求特工们将环境本身拖曳.

blocks.en: 3.4 Artifact-Centric Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.4 人工-儿科评价

blocks.en: Operationalizing the validation stage of the design loop, EngiWorld evaluates the engineering artifacts submitted at termination using programmatic verifiers. Each verifier reopens the submitted files, extracts the properties required by the task, and checks them against structural requirements or tolerance-bounded numerical criteria. The checks cover geometric dimensions and topology, simulation quantities, schematic connectivity, building-model entities and relationships, and 3D scene structure. For Multi-software tasks, verifiers additionally inspect intermediate artifacts and consistency across workflow stages. For binary tasks, all required acceptance criteria must pass to obtain S i = 1 S_{i}=1 . For quantitative design tasks, the verifier first checks engineering feasibility through F i F_{i} and then computes the quality score Q i Q_{i} only for feasible outputs; infeasible submissions receive Q i = 0 Q_{i}=0 . Missing, invalid, or unreadable deliverables fail the corresponding criteria. Verifiers are tested with reference artifacts, alternative valid solutions, and controlled defective submissions to ensure that they accept valid realizations and detect task-relevant violations. Detailed checker implementations, numerical tolerances, and validation results are provided in Appendix B.2 and Appendix B.3 .
blocks.zh: EngiWorld在设计环的验证阶段开始运作,使用程序验证器对终止时提交的工程文物进行评估。 每个核查员重新打开所提交的文件,提取任务所需的属性,并根据结构要求或容限数字标准加以检查。 检查范围包括几何尺寸和地形、模拟数量、示意图连接、建筑模型实体和关系以及3D场景结构。 对于多软件任务,核查员额外检查中间文物和工作流程各阶段的一致性。 对于二进制任务,所有要求的接受标准都必须通过才能获得S i = 1 S_{i}=1. 对于定量设计任务,核查者首先通过F i F_{i}检查工程可行性,然后计算质量分数Q iQ_{i}只针对可行的产出;不可行的提交件收到Q i = 0 Q_{i}=0. 缺失,无效,或无法读取的可交付品没有达到相应的标准. 验证人通过参考文物、替代有效解决方案和有控制的缺陷的提交进行测试,以确保它们接受有效的实现并发现与任务有关的违规行为。 附录B.2和附录B.3提供了详细的核对器执行情况、数值容忍度和验证结果。

blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: In this section, we present the experimental setup and the main results of seven frontier models on EngiWorld (Sections 4.1 and 4.2 ), followed by ablation studies on observation design and interaction history (Section 4.3 ) and a failure analysis (Section 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍关于EngiWorld的7个前沿模型的实验设置和主要结果(第4.1和4.2节),然后是观测设计和相互作用历史的断裂研究(第4.3节)和故障分析(第4.4节)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Models. We evaluate seven frontier models: GPT-5.6-Sol (XHigh) ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , Claude Opus 5 (Max) ( Anthropic, 2026 ) , Kimi K3 (Max) ( Moonshot AI, 2026 ) , Gemini 3.7 Flash (High) ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) , Qwen 3.8 Max and Qwen 3.8 Flash (XHigh) ( Alibaba Cloud, 2026 ) , and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Max) ( DeepSeek, 2026 ) . Each model receives the same task specification and tool instructions in a zero-shot setting.

blocks.en: Task selection. To control evaluation cost, we evaluate all seven models on the same stratified subset of 300 tasks, comprising 152 CLI-interface tasks and 148 GUI-interface tasks. The subset allocates four or five tasks to each of 73 strata defined by software and task category, while covering all six engineering domains.
blocks.zh: 任务选择 。 为了控制评价费用,我们用300项任务的同一分层子集对所有七个模型进行评价,其中包括152项国家液化工机接口任务和148项GUI接口任务。 该子集将四五个任务分配给由软件和任务类别定义的73个层中的每个层,同时覆盖所有六个工程域.

blocks.en: Execution. Each episode starts from a clean Windows or Ubuntu virtual-machine snapshot with task-specific inputs and application states (Appendix B.1 ). Agents using the GUI interface operate through PyAutoGUI with 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 screenshots, whereas agents using the CLI interface issue terminal commands and scripts; images can be inspected through readimg . For both interfaces, we retain the most recent 15 interaction rounds. The default decision limits are 200 rounds for GUI-interface tasks and 100 for CLI-interface tasks, increased to 300 and 150, respectively, for Multi-software and Open-ended tasks.

blocks.en: Overall performance. Claude Opus 5 achieves the highest overall EngiScore at 44.3, followed by GPT-5.6 Sol at 38.0 (Table 2 ). The absolute scores remain low: all seven models receive zero scores on 128 of the 300 tasks (Figure C.1 ). Performance depends strongly on the interface. Claude and GPT perform similarly on the CLI interface, while Claude has an advantage on GUI tasks. DeepSeek obtains the highest CLI score among the remaining models, but succeeds on only three GUI tasks, indicating that strong command-line performance does not translate directly to visual interaction.
blocks.zh: 总体表现. Claude Opus 5以44.3的成绩达到总的Engis分数最高,其次是GPT-5.6 Sol以38.0的成绩(表2). 绝对分数仍然很低:所有7个模型在300项任务中的128项中获得零分(图C.1 ). 性能严重依赖于接口. Claude和GPT在CLI接口上同样进行表演,而Claude则在GUI任务上具有优势. DeepSeek在其余模型中获得了最高的CLI分数,但仅成功完成了三个GUI任务,表明强大的命令行性能并不直接转化为视觉交互.

blocks.en: Task types. Performance drops sharply when a task requires coordination across applications. Claude completes roughly half of the Single-software tasks and two thirds of the Image-based modeling tasks, but only 6 of 168 Multi-software attempts succeed across all models. Software-selection tasks are also difficult, with Claude solving only one quarter of them. These results point to a central limitation of agents: operating an individual application is easier than selecting tools, transferring intermediate artifacts, and preserving dependencies across a multi-stage workflow. In terms of the design loop, current agents can execute individual stages but break down at the transitions between them. Results for Quantitative design and Open-ended tasks are reported in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 任务类型。 当一项任务需要各应用程序之间的协调时,业绩就会急剧下降。 Claude完成了大约一半的单软件任务和三分之二的基于Image的建模任务,但168个多软件尝试中只有6个在所有模型中获得成功. 软件选择任务也很困难,克劳德只解决了其中的四分之一. 这些结果显示了代理人的集中限制:操作单个应用程序比选择工具、转移中间文物和在多阶段工作流程中保存依赖性容易。 在设计环路方面,目前的代理可以执行单个阶段,但在它们之间的过渡时分解. 附录C报告了定量设计和不限成员名额任务的结果。

blocks.en: Engineering domains. The domain results reveal substantial specialization across models (Figure 5 ). Claude leads in CAD, CAE, EDA, and BIM and ties GPT in CAM, whereas Qwen3.8 Max performs best in 3D visualization. CAM is the most difficult domain for every model. Domain rankings differ from task-type rankings: Qwen leads in 3D visualization despite its lower overall score, while Claude’s advantage on Image-based modeling does not extend uniformly across domains.
blocks.zh: 工程领域. 域内结果显示各模型具有实质性的专门性(图5)。 Claude在CAD,CAE,EDA,和BIM中领先,并在CAM中链接GPT,而Quen3.8 Max在3D可视化中表现最好. CAM是每个模型最困难的域. 域排名与任务类型排名不同: Quen在3D可视化方面领先,尽管总体得分较低,而Claude在基于图像的建模方面的优势并没有在各个领域中统一延伸.

blocks.en: Execution cost. Models average 54.9–120.5 interaction steps per task. GPT uses the fewest steps (54.9), followed by Claude (70.2). DeepSeek and Gemini achieve similar scores of approximately 25, but DeepSeek costs less than half as much; this gap comes from pricing rather than frugality, as DeepSeek generates 9.9K output tokens per step against Gemini’s 0.7K. Claude reaches the highest score at nearly twice GPT’s API cost.
blocks.zh: 处决费用。 模型平均每项任务54.9-120.5互动步骤. GPT使用最少的步骤(54.9),其次是克劳德(70.2). DeepSeek和双子座的得分相类似,约为25分,但DeepSeek的成本还不到一半;这一差距来自定价而不是节俭,因为DeepSeek对双子座的0.7K每步生成9.9K输出令牌. 克劳德以GPT近两倍的API成本达到最高分.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Performance by domain. Tasks involving multiple domains contribute to each relevant domain.
blocks.zh: 图4:按领域分列的业绩。 涉及多个领域的任务有助于每个相关领域。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Failure modes. DONE/FAIL are agent-declared termination signals; F1 receives zero credit from the verifier. Missing-field and missing-file failures are excluded.
blocks.zh: 图5:失败模式。 DODE/FAIL是代理声明的终止信号;F1从验证人那里得到零信用. 失踪现场和失踪档案的故障不包括在内。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation and Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 分析和分析

blocks.en: Table 3: Ablation on initial-image presentation. EngiScore with reference drawings in the environment (Env.) or the message (Msg.).
blocks.zh: 表3: 初始图像显示的偏差。 EngiScore带有环境参考图(Env.)或消息(Ms.

blocks.en: Table 4: Ablation on runtime image access in CLI. EngiScore with readimg disabled or enabled.
blocks.zh: 表4:CLI中运行时图像访问的功能障碍. EngiScore 有 readimg 已禁用或启用 。

blocks.en: We study how observation design and interaction history affect agent performance. The ablations vary reference-image presentation, runtime image access, accessibility information, screenshot resolution, and history length for GPT-5.6 Sol, Gemini 3.7 Flash, and Kimi K3. Detailed task-level gains and regressions are provided in Appendix C.4 .
blocks.zh: 我们研究观测设计和相互作用历史如何影响剂性能. 缩写不同参考图像呈现,运行时图像访问,访问信息,截图解析度,以及GPT-5.6 Sol,双子座3.7 Flash和Kimi K3的历史长度. 详细的任务水平收益和回归情况见附录C.4。

blocks.en: Initial-image presentation. Presenting reference drawings directly in the task message improves GUI performance for all three models, with GPT increasing from 15.0 to 31.7 (Table 4 ). The benefit is smaller on the CLI interface, where agents can retrieve the drawings through readimg , and reverses for Kimi. The aggregate improvement therefore does not imply uniform gains: for GPT, five tasks that were previously successful become failures after the presentation format changes. This result suggests that easier access to visual inputs can help agents locate task-relevant information, but does not ensure that they use it correctly.
blocks.zh: 初标映. 在任务信息中直接提交参考图,可以提高所有三种模型的GUI性能,GPT从15.0增加到31.7(表4)。 在CLI接口上好处较小,代理商可以通过readimg获取图纸,为Kimi反向. 因此,总体改进并不意味着统一收益:对于GPT来说,此前成功的五项任务在列报格式改变后成为失败. 这一结果表明,更容易获取视觉输入可以帮助代理查找与任务有关的信息,但不能确保代理正确使用.

blocks.en: Runtime image access. Runtime access to images improves Gemini on both CLI conditions but reduces Kimi’s score in both settings (Table 4 ). GPT benefits when an initial drawing is available and declines when it is not. Visual feedback can support artifact inspection and correction, but it can also trigger unnecessary revisions. The opposing effects across models indicate that the value of additional visual evidence depends on how an agent incorporates it into its execution strategy.
blocks.zh: 运行时图像访问 。 运行时间访问图像在两个CLI条件上都改善了双子座,但降低了Kimi在两种场合的得分(表4). 当初始图纸可用时,GPT会受益,如果不是,则会下降。 视觉反馈可以支持文物检查和矫正,但也可能引发不必要的修改. 各种模型的对立效应表明,额外视觉证据的价值取决于代理人如何将它纳入其执行战略。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Ablation on observation and history. Accessibility and resolution use GUI tasks; history includes both interfaces. A11y adds an accessibility tree to the screenshot. Resolution scales are relative to 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 .
blocks.zh: 图6:关于观测和历史的研究。 可访问性和分辨率使用GUI任务;历史包含两个接口. A11y在截图中增加了一棵无障碍树. 分辨率天平相对1920×1080 1920\时间1080.

blocks.en: Accessibility information. Adding an accessibility tree improves Kimi, changes GPT little, and lowers Gemini’s score (Figure 6 a). Although all three models use fewer decision rounds, the additional structured information increases API cost by 50.7–147.9%. Accessibility metadata can therefore shorten interaction sequences without improving the resulting artifact, showing that more structured observations do not automatically translate into better engineering decisions.
blocks.zh: 无障碍信息. 添加无障碍树能改善Kimi,改变GPT小幅,降低双子座的得分(图6 a). 虽然这三种模型都使用较少的决策回合,但额外的结构化信息使API成本增加了50.7-147.9%. 因此,无障碍元数据可以缩短交互序列而不改进由此产生的文物,表明更有条理的观测不会自动转化为更好的工程决策.

blocks.en: Screenshot resolution. The native 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 resolution produces the highest score for all three models (Figure 6 b). Reducing the resolution to 0.6 × 0.6\times lowers cost for GPT by 30.8% while preserving most of its score, but causes a much larger degradation for Kimi. At the task level, increasing resolution benefits Kimi on eleven tasks without losses, whereas GPT gains on ten and loses on ten. Higher visual fidelity thus improves average performance, but its benefit depends on the model and does not apply uniformly across tasks.
blocks.zh: 截图解析. 土生土长的1920×1080 1920\times 1080分辨率为所有三种型号产生最高得分(图6b). 将分辨率降低到0.6×0.6\时将GPT的成本降低30.8%,同时保留其大部分得分,但导致基米的退化程度更大. 在任务一级,增加分辨率有利于Kimi完成11项任务,没有损失,而GPT则增加10项,损失10项。 因此,较高的视觉忠贞度提高了平均性能,但其好处取决于模型,并不统一适用于各种任务。

blocks.en: Interaction history. The optimal history length is model dependent (Figure 6 c). Gemini benefits from extending the window from five to fifteen turns, GPT largely plateaus after ten, and Kimi performs best at ten. For Kimi, extending the history from ten to fifteen turns lowers EngiScore while increasing cost by 53.0%.
blocks.zh: 互动历史. 最佳历史长度取决于模型(图6 c). 双子座从将窗口从5个转弯扩展至15个转弯,GPT在10个转弯后基本达到高原,Kimi的表现最好达到10个转弯. 对Kimi来说,将历史从10年延长到15年将降低Engiscore,同时将成本提高53.0%。

blocks.en: 4.4 Failure Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 失败分析

blocks.en: We classify failures by their terminal outcome: DONE with a zero score, decision-turn exhaustion, explicit FAIL , runtime-limit violation, and unexpected desktop closure or restart. The first two categories account for 94.1% of failures in the main evaluation (Figure 5 ), indicating that most unsuccessful runs either terminate before satisfying the verifier or fail to complete within the available interaction budget. These two dominant failure modes correspond to distinct breakages of the design loop: declaring completion without verified artifacts reflects a failure at the validation stage, whereas decision-turn exhaustion reflects a breakdown during the construction stage.
blocks.zh: 我们按其最终结果对失败进行分类: 以零分完成,决定回合用尽,明确 FAIL,运行时间限制违反,以及意外的桌面关闭或重启. 前两类占主要评价失败的94.1%(图5),表明大多数失败者要么在满足核查者要求之前结束运行,要么在现有的互动预算范围内未能完成运行。 这两种主要故障模式对应于设计循环的明显断裂:在没有经过核实的文物的情况下宣布完成反映了验证阶段的故障,而决策转折耗尽则反映了施工阶段的故障。

blocks.en: Completion declarations. Declared completion is the dominant failure mode for GPT and Claude: 87.0% and 73.9% of their retained failures end with DONE , compared with 39.6% for Gemini. These episodes produce a terminal signal without satisfying the artifact checks, often because of incorrect geometry or broken consistency across workflow stages (Table D.3 ). The gap between declared completion and verified success highlights the difficulty of judging engineering correctness from the visible software state alone.
blocks.zh: 完成申报. 宣布完成是GPT和Claude的主要失败模式:87.0%和73.9%的保留失败以DONE结束,而双子座的失败率为39.6%. 这些插曲产生一个终端信号而不满足文物检查,这往往是由于几何学不正确或工作流程各阶段不一致(表D.3). 宣布完成与核实成功之间的差距凸显了仅从可见软件状态判断工程正确性的困难.

blocks.en: Execution limits. Decision-turn exhaustion is most common for Gemini, both Qwen models, and DeepSeek, and occurs more frequently on the GUI interface than on the CLI interface (Figure D.2 ). It accounts for 55.3% of GUI failures and 36.6% of CLI failures. Explicit FAIL , runtime-limit failures, and desktop interruptions are much less frequent, while runtime-limit failures are concentrated in a small number of long-running executions, including 28 DeepSeek runs and 9 Claude runs that reach the five-hour limit.
blocks.zh: 执行限制。 双子座最常见的是决定转折疲劳,既包括Quen模型,也包括DeepSeek,在GUI接口上发生频率比在CLI接口(图D.2 )更频繁. 它占GUI失败的55.3%,占CLI失败的36.6%. 明确FAIL,运行时间限制故障,以及桌面中断的频率要低得多,而运行时间限制故障则集中在少数长期执行中,包括28个DeepSeek运行和9个达到5小时限制的克劳德运行.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced EngiWorld , a benchmark structured around the complete design loop, to evaluate LLM and MLLM agents on professional engineering workflows spanning 6 domains: CAD, CAE, CAM, BIM, EDA, and 3D visualization. The benchmark contains 1,301 expert-curated tasks across 26 software platforms and 6 task types, with GUI and CLI interfaces covering individual tools and multiple-stage workflows. Its artifact-centric evaluation, built on a unified domain-verifier suite, checks submitted artifacts for geometric, physical, connectivity, simulation, and cross-stage consistency, while preserving continuous quality scores for quantitative designs. Across seven frontier agents, the strongest reaches an EngiScore of 44.3, but only 3.6% of multi-software attempts succeed, with failures concentrated in unsatisfied engineering constraints and deliverables that agents did not verify before completion. This result exposes a fundamental gap between tool operation and reliable engineering execution, positioning EngiWorld as a rigorous foundation for building industrial agents that go beyond operating individual tools to close the engineering design loop.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了EngiWorld(EngiWorld),这是一个围绕整个设计循环构建的基准,用于评价LLM和MLLM代理商的专业工程工作流程,涉及6个领域:CAD,CAE,CAM,BIM,EDA,以及3D可视化. 该基准包含26个软件平台和6个任务类型的1,301项专家确定的任务,GUI和CLI接口涵盖单个工具和多阶段工作流程. 其以文物为中心的评价建立在统一的域-验证套件基础上,检查提交的文物几何,物理,连接,模拟,跨阶段一致性,同时为定量设计保留连续的质量分数. 在7个前沿特工中,最强者达到44.3的Engis分数,但多软件尝试中只有3.6%成功,失败集中在未满足的工程限制和交付品上,而代理商在完成之前没有核实这些限制和交付品。 这一结果暴露了工具操作和可靠的工程执行之间的根本差距,将EngiWorld定位为建设工业代理商的坚实基础,超越操作单个工具来关闭工程设计环路.

blocks.en: Appendix A Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 附录A 数据集构建

blocks.en: EngiWorld is constructed through an expert-led, AI-assisted pipeline grounded in real engineering workflows and professional software environments. As illustrated in Figure A.1 , domain experts define the task objectives, engineering artifacts, and evaluation criteria, while AI is used to standardize task specifications, assist artifact construction, and implement programmatic verifiers. Each stage is reviewed and iteratively refined by experts before the resulting task is included in the benchmark. The construction process consists of three stages: task construction, task-instance construction, and evaluation-criteria construction.
blocks.zh: EngiWorld是通过一个以真正的工程工作流程和专业软件环境为基础的由专家牵头的AI辅助管道建造的. 如图A.1所示,域专家界定了任务目标、工程文物和评价标准,而AI则用于标准化任务规格、协助文物建造和执行方案核查员。 每一阶段都由专家进行审查和反复改进,然后将由此产生的任务列入基准。 建设过程包括三个阶段:任务建设,任务论证建设,评审标准建设.

blocks.en: Figure A.1: Dataset construction pipeline. Representative engineering scenarios are transformed into executable benchmark tasks through task construction, task-instance construction, and evaluation-criteria construction, with expert review and validation throughout the process.
blocks.zh: 图A.1:数据集建设管道. 代表性工程设想方案通过任务建设,任务论证建设,评价标准建设,贯穿全过程,通过专家评审和论证,转化为可执行的基准任务.

blocks.en: A.1 Task Construction
blocks.zh: A.1 任务构建

blocks.en: Task construction begins with the selection of software platforms and workbenches across the six engineering domains covered by EngiWorld. For each environment, experts identify representative scenarios from real engineering workflows and software-specific resources, including official documentation, user guides, tutorials, technical references, and engineering textbooks. These scenarios are selected to reflect the characteristic capabilities and workflows of the corresponding software.
blocks.zh: EngiWorld覆盖的六个工程领域,任务构建首先选择软件平台和工作本位. 对于每一种环境,专家们从真正的工程工作流程和软件专用资源,包括正式文件、用户指南、教程、技术参考资料和工程教科书中确定有代表性的设想。 选择这些情景是为了反映相应软件的特征能力和工作流程.

blocks.en: Each scenario is formulated as a result-oriented task specification that defines the engineering objective, available inputs, required deliverables, and relevant constraints. AI assists in standardizing the structure and wording of the specification so that tasks across heterogeneous software environments follow a consistent format. For tasks initialized from existing engineering artifacts, observable properties remain encoded in the provided task state, allowing the instruction to focus on the intended outcome and required deliverables. Experts then review and finalize the specification, which serves as the common basis for task instantiation and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 每种设想方案都是以注重结果的任务规格拟订的,其中界定了工程目标、现有投入、所需交付成果和相关制约因素。 大赦国际协助使规格的结构和措辞标准化,以便不同软件环境的任务遵循一致的格式。 对于从现有工程文物中初始化的任务,可观测属性仍然在规定的任务状态中编码,使指令能够侧重于预期成果和必要的可交付成果。 然后,专家们审查并最后确定这一规格,作为任务即时处理和评价的共同基础。

blocks.en: A.2 Task Instance Construction
blocks.zh: A.2 任务实例构建

blocks.en: Once the task specification is finalized, the corresponding task instance is constructed in the designated software environment. Experts prepare the initial engineering state and construct a validated reference realization in the corresponding professional software, with AI assistance during artifact preparation and iterative refinement. Depending on the domain, a task instance may involve CAD geometry, PCB designs, simulation models, BIM models, manufacturing files, structured parameters, or 3D scenes.
blocks.zh: 任务规格定稿后,相应的任务实例在指定的软件环境中构建. 专家准备初步工程状态,并在相应的专业软件中构建一个经过验证的参考实现,在文物准备和迭代完善期间得到AI的协助. 根据域,任务实例可能涉及CAD几何,PCB设计,模拟模型,BIM模型,制造文件,结构参数,或3D场景.

blocks.en: The reference realization provides a verified solution and supports the extraction of task-specific engineering quantities used during construction and validation. Multiple valid realizations can satisfy the same task specification when they meet the required engineering conditions. For multi-software tasks, intermediate artifacts preserve the dependencies between successive workflow stages and may serve as inputs to subsequent applications. For open-choice tasks, the engineering requirements and deliverables are fixed while the agent retains flexibility in selecting tools and execution order.
blocks.zh: 参考实现提供了经核实的解决方案,并支持提取在施工和验证过程中使用的特定任务工程量. 多重有效实现在满足所需的工程条件时,可以满足相同的任务规格. 对于多软件任务,中间工艺品保存了相继工作流程阶段之间的依存关系,并可作为后续应用程序的投入. 对于开放式选择任务,工程要求和交付品是固定的,而代理人在选择工具和执行命令方面保留了灵活性.

blocks.en: A.3 Evaluation Criteria and Verification
blocks.zh: A.3 评价标准和核查

blocks.en: Evaluation criteria are derived directly from the engineering requirements of each task. Experts specify the properties and tolerances that characterize successful completion, covering quantities such as geometry and topology, component placement, clearances, connectivity, physical or simulation outputs, manufacturing constraints, and cross-artifact relationships. Together, these criteria define the engineering conditions under which a submitted artifact is considered valid.
blocks.zh: 评价标准直接来自每项任务的工程要求。 专家们具体说明了成功完成的特性和耐受性,包括几何和地形、组件布置、清除、连接、物理或模拟输出、制造限制和跨艺术关系等数量。 这些标准共同确定了所提交的文物被视为有效的工程条件。

blocks.en: AI assists in translating these expert-defined criteria into a task-specific programmatic verifier. The verifier extracts the relevant properties from the submitted final and, when required, intermediate artifacts and applies the corresponding checks. For example, a CAD task may verify dimensions, material regions, mounting structures, openings, clearances, and interference directly from the submitted geometry, while a simulation task may evaluate solver outputs and derived physical quantities. Numerical requirements are evaluated using explicit task-specific tolerances.
blocks.zh: 大赦国际协助将这些专家界定的标准转化为具体任务的方案核查员。 核查人从提交的最终和必要时的中间文物中提取相关属性,并适用相应的检查. 例如,一个CAD任务可以直接从提交的几何中核实维度,物质区域,安装结构,开口,清除和干扰,而一个模拟任务可以评价解析器输出和产生的物理量. 数字要求使用明确的任务耐受性来评价。

blocks.en: The verifier is validated together with the task instance in the target software environment. Reference realizations are used to confirm the expected acceptance behavior, while controlled variants are used to exercise task-relevant failure conditions and numerical boundaries. For tasks admitting multiple valid realizations, alternative solutions are additionally examined when applicable. Experts finally review the instruction, task instance, reference realization, and verifier as a complete task package. Tasks with identified inconsistencies are revised and revalidated before inclusion in EngiWorld.
blocks.zh: 验证器与任务实例一起在目标软件环境中验证. 引用实现用于确认预期的接受行为,而控制变体则用于执行与任务相关的失败条件和数字边界. 对于接受多重有效实现的任务,在适用时将额外审查替代解决方案。 专家最后将指令、任务实例、参考实现和核查作为完整的一揽子任务加以审查。 已查明不一致的任务在列入EngiWorld之前将加以修订和重新鉴定。

blocks.en: Appendix B Engineering Evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录B 工程 评价

blocks.en: B.1 Software Environments
blocks.zh: B.1 软件环境

blocks.en: Each task runs in an isolated Windows or Ubuntu virtual machine with the required engineering software installed. EngiWorld provides 37 environments: 26 software-specific environments, 10 composite environments supporting multi-software workflows, and one dedicated environment for Open-ended tasks. Table B.1 lists the 26 software-specific environments, with FreeCAD Modeling and Path treated as separate workbench environments. Before each episode, the harness restores a clean snapshot, copies the task inputs, prepares the workspace, and opens the relevant documents. Cross-application tasks use a shared workspace containing the participating applications. The software versions listed in Table B.1 refer to the software-specific environments; composite environments may use different versions. For example, the Archicad–OpenStudio workflow uses OpenStudio 3.10 on Windows.
blocks.zh: 每个任务都使用一个孤立的Windows或Ubuntu虚拟机运行,并安装了所需的工程软件. EngiWorld提供了37个环境:26个软件专用环境,10个支持多软件工作流程的复合环境,以及一个用于无限制任务的专用环境. 表B.1列出了26个软件专用环境,FreeCAD Modeling and Path作为单独的工作台环境处理. 在每集之前,套装会恢复一个干净的快照,复制任务输入,准备工作空间,并打开相关文档. 交叉应用任务使用包含参与应用的共享工作空间. 表B.1所列的软件版本指的是软件特有的环境;复合环境可能使用不同的版本. 例如,Archicad–OpenStudio工作流程在Windows上使用OpenStudio 3.10.

blocks.en: After an episode ends, the verifier runs inside the task VM and uses the application’s data model or a format-specific parser. The checker stack includes CadQuery/OCCT for solids, ezdxf for drawings, IfcOpenShell for building models, native FreeCAD and Blender APIs, Abaqus odbAccess for simulation results, and SQLite for EnergyPlus/OpenStudio outputs. Observation, budget, and history settings follow Section 4.1 .
blocks.zh: 剧集结束后,核查者会运行在任务VM内部,并使用应用程序的数据模型或格式特定解析器. 检查器堆栈包括用于固件的CadQuery/OCCT,用于绘图的ezdxf,用于构建模型的IfcOpenShell,本地FreeCAD和Blender APIS,用于模拟结果的Abaqus odbAccess,以及用于EnergyPlus/OpenStudio输出的SQLite. 观察、预算和历史背景见第4.1节。

blocks.en: Table B.1: Software environments. The 37 environment configurations in EngiWorld: 26 software-specific environments, 10 composite environments, and one Open-ended environment.
blocks.zh: 表B.1:软件环境。 EngiWorld的37个环境配置:26个软件专用环境,10个复合环境,以及1个开放环境.

blocks.en: B.2 Artifact Checks and Scoring
blocks.zh: B.2 人造物检查和鉴定

blocks.en: After termination, the verifier reopens the submitted deliverables and extracts the properties required by the task. Neutral formats such as STEP, DXF, and IFC are re-imported so that export errors affect the result. Numerical properties use task-specific tolerances, while connectivity, entity roles, and required references use exact checks (Table B.2 ). Missing or unreadable deliverables fail the corresponding criteria. When a file format permits equivalent names or representations, the checker accepts them while retaining the required geometry, physical settings, and numerical constraints. Integrity checks protect designated inputs and prevent scripted bypasses of the GUI interface; implementation-specific signing and certificate rules are described by the corresponding environment configuration.
blocks.zh: 终止后,核查人重新开放所提交的交付品,并提取任务所需的属性. STEP,DXF,IFC等中性格式被重新导入,以便导出错误影响结果. 数字属性使用特定任务耐受性,而连接性,实体作用,以及需要的参考使用精确的检查(表B.2.). 缺少或无法读取的交付品没有达到相应的标准。 当一个文件格式允许等量名称或表示时,检查者接受它们,同时保留所需的几何,物理设置和数字限制. 完整性检查保护指定输入,防止脚本绕行GUI接口;执行特定签名和证书规则由相应的环境配置描述.

blocks.en: Expected outcomes are assigned from the task requirements before verifier execution. blocks.en: Across the 300 main-evaluation tasks, 128 receive a zero score from all seven models (Figure C.1 ). Among the remaining 172 tasks, 37 are solved by one model, 35 by two, and 29 by all seven. The all-zero set is concentrated in Single-software tasks, but also includes 22 Multi-software, 18 Software-selection, and 12 Quantitative design tasks. This distribution shows that the aggregate performance gap is not caused only by a small number of difficult cross-application workflows; many individual application tasks remain unsolved by every evaluated model.

blocks.en: On ZBrush task 04, both Gemini 3.7 Flash and GPT-5.6 Sol produce valid surfaces with full evaluation-grid coverage. GPT achieves a lower height-field RMSE, 0.07650 versus 0.15098 OBJ units, and a higher score, 0.892 versus 0.804 (Table C.2 ). The initial design scores 0.880: GPT improves it slightly, whereas Gemini produces a valid surface of lower quality. For this task, the score measures the submitted surface’s quality rather than its improvement over the initial design.
blocks.zh: ZBrush任务04,双子座3.7闪电和GPT-5.6 索尔产生有效的表面,并有完整的评价网覆盖. GPT实现了较低的高度场RMSE,0.07650对0.15098 OBJ单位,更高的分数,0.892对0.804(表C.2. 最初的设计得分0.880:GPT稍有改进,而双子座则产生质量较低的有效表面. 对于这项任务,分数衡量提交的表面质量,而不是相对于初步设计的改进。

blocks.en: Gemini’s KiCad task-01 output scores 0.982, compared with 0.647 for the baseline layout. The evaluator-computed weighted cost decreases from 64.2085 to 3.2135, and route length decreases from 53.1618 to 40.1688 mm. All four movable components reach their target positions, with zero vias and minimum spacing of 4.6174 mm against a 2.0 mm requirement. The remaining cost comes from the route-length term (Table C.2 ). The gap to 1.0 therefore reflects residual engineering cost, not the fraction of requirements left unmet.
blocks.zh: 双子座的KiCad任务-01输出得分0.982,而基准布局则为0.647. 评价员计算的加权费用从64.2085降至3.2135,路线长度从53.1618毫米降至40.1688毫米。 所有四个可移动组件都达到目标位置,0号通道和最小间距为4.6174毫米,与2.0毫米要求相对应. 其余费用来自路线长度(表C.2)。 因此,1.0的差额反映了剩余工程费用,而不是未得到满足的一小部分。

blocks.en: On the same ZBrush task 04, Qwen 3.8 Flash obtains an RMSE of 0.18097 OBJ units but scores zero: its mesh contains degenerate faces, overlapping projected triangles, and multiple surface heights at the sampling points. GPT also scores zero on ZBrush task 05 because its grid coverage is 94.75%, below the required 98%. The RMSE remains a diagnostic measurement for these rejected artifacts, but it cannot compensate for invalid topology or insufficient coverage. Partial scores distinguish the quality of admissible designs; the validity gate prevents a geometrically defective output from receiving credit for approximation accuracy alone.
blocks.zh: 在相同的ZBrush任务04上,Quen 3.8 Flash获得了0.18097 OBJ单位的RMSE,但得分为零:它的网格包含变质面,重叠的预测三角形,以及采样点的多个表面高度. GPT在ZBrush任务05上也得零分,因为其网格覆盖率为94.75%,低于所要求的98%. RMSE仍然是对这些被拒文物的诊断测量,但它不能补偿无效的地形学或覆盖不足. 部分分数区分了可接受设计的质量;有效性门使一个几何缺陷的输出无法仅获得近似准确性的信用.

blocks.en: The main evaluation includes four Open-ended tasks, numbered 02, 07, 09, and 10, derived from the KiCad–OpenSCAD–FreeCAD–Blender Multi-software tasks. Tasks 02 and 09 have directly matched Multi-software counterparts and are used for the paired analysis below. Figure C.2 summarizes their shared engineering requirements; the workflow and delivery differences are described afterward.

blocks.en: For both tasks, the Multi-software instruction requires KiCad to extract the board geometry and parameters, OpenSCAD to construct the enclosure, FreeCAD to assemble the parts and check clearances, and Blender to produce a visual review. It specifies this sequence and 18 artifacts, including intermediate handoffs, reports, a rendered review, and a toolchain invocation log. The Open-ended instruction permits any available tools, scripts, or libraries in any order. It requires one final STEP assembly containing the enclosure, PCB, installed components, and task-specific features, which is evaluated directly against the geometric design requirements. The target assembly is shared; the required construction process and supporting deliverables change.
blocks.zh: 对于这两个任务,多软件指令要求KiCad提取棋盘几何和参数,OpenSCAD构建附文,FreeCAD组装部件和检查许可,Blender生成视觉审查. 它具体规定了这一序列和18件文物,包括中间交割、报告、提供的审查和工具链引用日志。 开放式指令允许任何可用的工具、脚本或图书馆按任何顺序使用。 它需要最后的STEP组装,其中包含附件,PCB,安装的组件和任务特定特征,直接根据几何设计要求进行评估. 目标组装是共享的;必要的建造过程和支持可交付成果的变化。

blocks.en: All seven models fail the Multi-software versions of tasks 02 and 09. On Open-ended task 09, however, Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.7 Flash, Qwen 3.8 Max, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash succeed; Open-ended task 02 remains unsuccessful for all seven models (Table C.3 ). The paired Gemini and Qwen 3.8 Max trajectories for task 09 locate the Multi-software failures and the changes in the successful Open-ended workflows.
blocks.zh: 所有七个模型都失败了任务02和09的多软件版本. 然而,关于09号不限成员名额任务,克劳德·奥普斯5,双子座3.7 Flash,Quen 3.8 Max和DeepSeek V4.1 闪光成功;所有7种模式的02期不限名额任务仍未成功(表C.3)。 配对的双子座和Quen 3.8 Max 09任务轨迹定位了多软件故障和成功开放工作流程的变化.

blocks.en: On task 09, Gemini submits a 478-byte toolchain_invocation_log.json , below the source evaluator’s 500-byte minimum. Qwen 3.8 Max reaches its 150-step limit with the same required file missing. Its last recorded action checks the required artifacts after completing the Blender stage. Both runs fail the delivery requirements before their assemblies are checked for geometric validity.

blocks.en: In the Gemini and Qwen 3.8 Max Open-ended task-09 trajectories, the agents construct the assembly through FreeCAD scripting and submit a STEP file that passes the final geometry evaluator. Qwen 3.8 Max completes this run in 30 steps under the same 150-step budget as its Multi-software run. Gemini completes its Open-ended run in 41 steps under a 150-step limit; its Multi-software run ends after 44 steps under a 150-step limit, with the log-size check still failing. Gemini therefore fails the Multi-software task on a delivery check despite remaining within its step budget.

blocks.en: For these two models, direct construction produces an assembly that passes the geometry checks, while the prescribed workflow fails on intermediate delivery obligations. blocks.en: C.4 Additional Ablation Analysis
blocks.zh: C.4 附加分析

blocks.en: Additional observations can change which tasks succeed as well as the quality of partially successful outputs. We separate these effects using matched task scores and examine the task requirements behind the opposing outcomes.
blocks.zh: 其他观察可以改变哪些任务成功以及部分成功产出的质量。 我们利用相应的任务分数来区分这些影响,并审查相反结果背后的任务要求。

blocks.en: Providing the reference drawing in the message improves GUI EngiScore for all three models, while Kimi’s CLI score decreases from 40.0 to 36.7 (Table 4 ). GPT’s GUI gain combines 15 failures becoming successes and five successes becoming failures across 60 tasks. The gain is therefore a net result of different task outcomes, rather than an improvement shared by every task.
blocks.zh: 提供信息中的参考图纸可以改善GUI Engis分数对所有三种模型的应用,而Kimi的CLI分数则从40.0降至36.7(表4)。 GPT的GUI收益将15个失败变成成功,5个成功变成60个任务的失败。 因此,这一收益是不同任务成果的净结果,而不是每项任务的共同改进。

blocks.en: The opposing GPT outcomes on FreeCAD task 01 and Blender task 02 distinguish reference access from artifact construction. FreeCAD task 01, which becomes successful with message placement, requires a mounting plate whose drawing supplies dimensions and whose supplement supplies four through-hole locations. Direct presentation makes one of these two required information sources available at the start. Blender task 02 instead becomes unsuccessful. It requires ten courses of ten bricks as 100 disconnected islands within a single mesh object. Recognizing the wall’s appearance leaves its mesh connectivity to be constructed correctly. These requirements explain why easier access to a reference can remove an information-retrieval step without ensuring that the resulting artifact satisfies its structural constraints.
blocks.zh: 与FreeCAD任务01和Blender任务02相反的GPT结果将参考访问与文物建筑区分开来. FreeCAD 01任务随着消息的放置而成功,需要安装一个图板,其图纸尺寸和补充材料通过4个孔位提供. 直接列报使这两个必要的信息来源之一在开始时即可获得。 Blender 02 任务反而不成功。 它需要十道十块砖 作为100个断开的岛屿在一个网状物体内。 由于认识到隔离墙的外观,其网状连接无法正确构建。 这些要求解释了为什么更容易获得参考材料可以移除检索信息的步骤,而不能确保由此产生的成果满足其结构限制。

blocks.en: Enabling readimg improves Gemini on both task sets and lowers Kimi on both (Table 4 ). With a message-based initial drawing, Kimi gains two successful tasks but loses five. FreeCAD task 39 becomes successful, whereas task 42 becomes unsuccessful. Task 39 combines a bearing bore, a front window, top ribs, and mounting holes. Task 42 requires a central through-bore, four closed-end radial slots with specified depth, and a hole array with a specified angular phase. Both require exactly one valid connected solid.
blocks.zh: 启用 readimg 改善了双子座的任务组合,降低了 Kimi 的任务组合(表4 )。 通过基于消息的初始绘图,Kimi获得了两项成功的任务,但损失了五项. FreeCAD任务39获得成功,而任务42失败. 任务39将轴承、前窗、上肋和隆起孔结合起来。 任务42需要一个中央通过波段,四个有指定深度的闭端射线槽,以及一个有指定角相的孔阵列. 两者都需要一个完全有效的连接固体.

blocks.en: A rendered view can support comparison of the visible arrangement of these features, but does not by itself establish bore connectivity, slot depth, or the validity of the exported solid. These properties require geometric checks alongside visual inspection. The task pair therefore illustrates a distinction between making visual feedback available and verifying the engineering constraints.
blocks.zh: 所给出的观点可以支持对这些特征的可见安排进行比较,但本身并不能确定承载的连接、槽深度或出口固体的有效性。 这些属性需要在进行目视检查的同时进行几何检查. 因此,任务组合说明了提供视觉反馈和核实工程制约因素之间的区别。

blocks.en: GPT’s EngiScore increases from 66.7 to 68.3 with a message-based drawing but decreases from 48.1 to 41.5 without one. An initial drawing could give the agent a target for interpreting intermediate renders. However, the two settings contain different task sets: each supports a matched comparison of readimg on versus off, but their difference also includes task composition. The GPT reversal therefore motivates an interaction hypothesis rather than isolating the interaction between initial-image availability and runtime image access.
blocks.zh: GPT的Engiscounter从66.7增加到68.3,采用基于信件的绘图,但从48.1减少到41.5,没有1。 初步绘图可以使代理人获得解释中间成份的目标。 然而,两种设置包含不同的任务组合:每种组合支持匹配的readimg对off的比较,但其差异还包括任务构成. 因此,GPT逆转激发了一个交互假说,而不是隔离初始图像可用性和运行时图像访问之间的相互作用.

blocks.en: Adding an accessibility tree improves Kimi’s EngiScore but lowers Gemini’s and GPT’s (Figure 6 a). GPT has eight tasks gaining nonzero scores and eight losing them, yet its EngiScore decreases from 29.84 to 29.05. The gains contribute 7.195 points, while the losses remove 8.000 points. A further 0.014-point improvement on an already nonzero task only partly offsets this deficit. Equal numbers of gains and losses therefore conceal unequal amounts of engineering credit.
blocks.zh: 添加无障碍树会改善Kimi的Engiscore,但会降低双子座和GBT(图6a). GPT有8项任务获得非零分,8项失败,然而其Engiscore却从29.84降至29.05. 收益贡献了7.195分,而损失则消除了8.000分. 如果在一项已经非零任务上进一步改进0.014点,则只能部分抵销这一赤字。 因此,同等数量的损益掩盖了工程信贷的不平等数额。

blocks.en: Within FreeCAD, task 14 becomes successful with the tree, while task 20 becomes unsuccessful. Task 14 adds and fuses a cylindrical crossbar between two posts. Task 20 requires positioning an upright support, fusing it to a base, and cutting a through-hole along a specified axis. Textual interface information can help identify controls, but the requested operations still depend on the selected body, geometric placement, and feature direction. The opposing outcomes within one application show that the benefit cannot be reduced to whether that application exposes accessibility information; the relevant question is whether the information supports the particular geometric operation.
blocks.zh: 在FreeCAD内部,任务14随树而成功,任务20则失败. 任务14在两个哨所之间添加并引信一个圆柱形交叉栏. 任务20要求将一个直立的支架定位,将支架安装在基座上,并沿着指定的轴线切割一个通孔. 文字界面信息可以帮助识别控件,但请求的操作仍然取决于选定的机体,几何定位,以及特征方向. 一个应用程序内部的相反结果表明,不能将好处降低到该应用程序是否暴露了无障碍信息;相关问题是信息是否支持特定的几何操作.

blocks.en: Native resolution produces the highest EngiScore for all three models (Figure 6 b). For GPT, increasing resolution from 0.6 × 0.6\times to 1.0 × 1.0\times yields ten new full-score outcomes, contributing 10.000 points, while ten tasks lose a combined 9.140 points. This imbalance accounts for the increase from 28.98 to 29.84 despite the regressions. Kimi gains eleven nonzero outcomes and loses none, so its improvement is more consistent across tasks.
blocks.zh: 原生分辨率为所有三种模型产生最高的Engiscore(图6b). 对于GPT,分辨率从0.6×0.6\时提高到1.0×1.0\时,得出10个新的全分结果,贡献了10000分,而10项任务损失了9140分的总和. 尽管出现倒退,但这种不平衡还是导致从28.98增加到29.84。 Kimi取得了11项非零成果,没有损失,因此其改进更加一致。

blocks.en: GPT’s newly successful KiCad task 06 requires repairing a QFN-48 footprint’s exposed pad, paste apertures, and courtyard while preserving the peripheral pads. Its small, closely spaced features make it a relevant case for improved visual discrimination. The newly unsuccessful Blender task 02 instead requires the 100 disconnected brick islands described above. Greater image detail may aid feature selection, but the mesh-structure requirement remains a separate construction obligation. The contrast distinguishes a task that requires selecting fine geometric features from one that requires constructing a particular mesh structure.
blocks.zh: GPT新成功完成的KiCad 06任务要求修复QFN-48足迹暴露的垫,粘孔,以及庭院,同时保留外围垫. 它的狭小、空间紧密的特点使它成为改善视觉歧视的一个相关案例。 新近不成功的Blender 02任务需要上述100个断开的砖岛。 更大的图像细节可能有助于选择特征,但网状结构要求仍然是单独的建筑义务。 对比度将需要选择精细几何特征的任务与需要构建特定网状结构的任务区分开来.

blocks.en: Increasing history from ten to fifteen turns lowers Kimi’s EngiScore from 26.21 to 20.12, while GPT changes little, from 36.61 to 36.74 (Figure 6 c). For Kimi, five tasks gain nonzero scores and eleven lose them, contributing + 4.368 +4.368 and − 10.532 -10.532 points, respectively. Changes between already nonzero scores add 0.073 points. The decline is thus dominated by tasks losing all credit rather than by small quality reductions across partially successful designs.
blocks.zh: 历史从10个增加到15个,使基米的恩吉斯得分从26.21降至20.12,而GPT变化不大,从36.61降至36.74(图6c)。 对基米来说,5项任务获得非零分,11项损失,分别贡献+4.368+4.368和−10.532-10.532分. 已经非零分之间的变化加上0.073分. 因此,下降主要是丧失所有信贷的任务,而不是部分成功的设计中质量的微小下降。

blocks.en: GPT’s near-constant mean has a different explanation. Seven tasks gain nonzero scores, contributing 6.899 points, while seven formerly full-score tasks lose 7.000 points. ZBrush task 03, which remains nonzero in both settings, improves from 0.61434 to 0.843902 and contributes another 0.230 points. These three components account for the net 0.129-point increase. The task optimizes a gasket sealing-band surface under topology and coverage constraints, so the higher score records a quality improvement that a binary gain/loss count would miss. Its fifteen-turn score still falls below the initial design’s 0.909292. Longer history therefore improves this output relative to the ten-turn run without establishing an improvement over the starting design, consistent with the distinction in Appendix C.2 .
blocks.zh: GPT 近乎恒定的刻意, 7项任务获得非零分,贡献6.899分,而7项前全分任务损失7.000分. ZBrush任务03在两种场合都保持非零,从0.61434提高到0.843902,又贡献0.230分. 这三个部分占净增长0.129个百分点。 任务在地形和覆盖限制下优化了垫片封带表面,因此较高的分数记录了质量的提高,二进制损益计数会错过. 它的十五转分仍然低于最初设计的0.909292. 因此,与十轮运行相比,历史较长的这一产出得到了改进,而没有按照附录C.2中的区别,对起始设计作出改进。

blocks.en: Appendix D Case Studies
blocks.zh: 附录D 案例研究

blocks.en: D.1 Successful Workflow Cases
blocks.zh: D.1 成功的工作流程案例

blocks.en: Figure D.1: Successful single-software GUI workflows. The four rows show representative KiCad, AutoCAD, SolidWorks, and Blender executions. Intermediate edits and final checks or artifacts are connected by dashed arrows. All four runs pass their artifact verifiers.
blocks.zh: 图D.1:成功的单软件GUI工作流程. 四行显示代表Kicad、AutoCAD、SolidWorks和Blender处决。 中间编辑和最终检查或文物用破折箭头连接. 4个都通过了他们的文物核查员。

blocks.en: Across these four GUI runs, the requested edits are retained in the delivered files together with the required electrical, geometric, or image properties. All four runs pass their task-specific artifact checks and receive a score of 1.0 (Figure D.1 ).
blocks.zh: 在这四个图形用户界面运行中,请求的编辑与所需的电气、几何或图像属性一起保留在交付的文件中。 这4次运行均通过任务特定文物检查,获得1.0分(图D.1.

blocks.en: In KiCad, the DATA0 – DATA7 labels encode eight distinct nets that establish the required one-to-one MCU–SRAM pin mapping. The agent adds the two required power flags while retaining the existing components and power and control connections. Checks on the saved schematic verify both the new data connections and the preserved circuitry, with zero electrical-rule errors.
blocks.zh: 在KiCad,DATA0 – DATA7标签编码了8个不同的网,以建立所需的1比1MCU–SRAM针头映射. 该代理机在保留现有组件以及权力和控制连接的同时,还增加了所需的两面动力旗. 检查保存的示意图,验证新数据连接和保存的电路,电规则错误为零.

blocks.en: In AutoCAD, rectangular arrays express the repeated geometry through shared spacing parameters. After constructing the outline and slots, the agent combines 5 × 3 5\times 3 and 4 × 2 4\times 2 arrays with offset origins to produce 23 staggered tube holes. The exported DXF retains the required coordinates, radii, entity types, and layer assignments, preserving the drawing’s geometric and organizational structure through export.
blocks.zh: 在AutoCAD中,长方形阵列通过共享间隔参数表达重复的几何. 在构造轮廓和槽后,该剂结合了5×3 5\time 3和4×2 4\time 2的阵列与偏移起源,产生23个交错的管孔. 出口的DXF保留了所需的坐标、光度、实体类型和层层任务,通过输出保留了绘图的几何和组织结构。

blocks.en: The SolidWorks edit changes relative placement while keeping part geometry fixed. The agent makes the sliding block movable, applies a Profile Center mate, and corrects the offset direction to align the XY centers and place the sliding block’s bottom face against the base’s top face. The exported STEP satisfies these placement constraints while retaining the original dimensions and two independent solids.
blocks.zh: SolidWorks编辑改变相对位置,同时保持部分几何固定. 代理制作滑动块的可移动性, 应用配置中心配对, 并校正偏移方向, 出口STEP满足了这些放置限制,同时保留了原来的尺寸和两个独立的固体.

blocks.en: In Blender, the agent bakes ambient occlusion into AO_Bake and packs the 512 × 512 512\times 512 image before saving answer.blend . Packing embeds the baked pixel data in the native file, preserving the computed image as part of the delivered scene.
blocks.zh: 在Blender中,代理将环境封存烤入AO_Bake中,并在保存答案.blend 之前将512×512 512\times 512图像装入. 包装将烤制的像素数据嵌入到本地文件中,将计算出来的图像作为交付的场景的一部分加以保存.

blocks.en: D.2 Failure Cases
blocks.zh: D.2 失败案件

blocks.en: We analyze five recorded failure categories: DONE with a zero score, decision-turn exhaustion, explicit FAIL, environment timeout, and agent-initiated desktop closure or restart. Across the main evaluation and ablations, 3,347 distinct zero-score runs fall into these categories. Their aggregate distribution and main-evaluation breakdown are reported in Tables D.1 and D.2 . Reused runs are counted once; required-field and missing-file failures are excluded from this analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们分析五个记录失败类别: 完成时为零分,决定回合耗尽,明确 FAIL,环境超时,代理启动桌面关闭或重新启动. 在整个主要评价和模拟中,3 347个明显的零分数属于这些类别。 表D.1和D.2报告其总体分布情况和主要评价细目。 重复使用的运行被计算一次;本次分析不包括要求的域和缺失文件故障.

blocks.en: Table D.1: Failure taxonomy across all experiments. Counts and shares of 3,347 distinct failed runs in the five analyzed categories. Reused runs count once; required-field and missing-file failures are excluded.
blocks.zh: 表D.1:所有实验的失败分类。 在分析的五个类别中,有3 347个明显失败的计算和份额。 重复使用运行计数一次;不包含需要的字段和缺失文件失败。

blocks.en: Table D.2: Failure counts by model. Main-evaluation failures on the shared 300-task set, grouped into the five analyzed categories. Required-field and missing-file failures are excluded.
blocks.zh: 表D.2:按模型分列的失败数。 共享的300项任务的主要评价失败,分为五个分析类别。 所需字段和缺失文件的故障不包括在内。

blocks.en: The failure composition differs substantially between interfaces (Figure D.2 ). Among the analyzed failures, decision-turn exhaustion accounts for 233 of 636 CLI failures (36.6%) and 471 of 851 GUI failures (55.3%). Completion without acceptance is more common on CLI, while explicit failure declarations and runtime-limit failures remain smaller components in both settings. The interface-level breakdown complements the model-level analysis in Figure 5 .
blocks.zh: 接口之间的故障构成差别很大(图D.2)。 在所分析的失败中,在636项CLI失败(36.6%)和851项GUI失败(55.3%)中,有233项是决策转向疲劳造成的。 在CLI中,未经接受完成更为常见,而明确的失败声明和运行时间限制的失败在两种情况下仍然是较小的组成部分. 界面层分解是对图5中的模型层分析的补充.

blocks.en: Figure D.2: Failure composition by interaction interface. Decision-turn exhaustion accounts for 36.6% of CLI failures and 55.3% of GUI failures; the remaining segments show the other four analyzed outcomes.
blocks.zh: 图D.2:按互动接口分列的失败构成。 决策转折耗尽占CLI故障的36.6%,占GUI故障的55.3%;其余部分显示其他四个分析结果.

blocks.en: Figure D.3: Multi-software failure cases. Recorded actions, submitted data, and observed outcomes are compared with independently rendered reference artifacts. The first three cases use the GUI interface and the fourth uses the CLI interface; all receive zero credit.
blocks.zh: 图D.3:多软件故障案例. 将记录的行动、提交的数据和观测结果与独立制作的参考文物进行比较。 前3个案例使用GUI接口,第4个案例使用CLI接口;全部获得零信用.

blocks.en: Independent checks identify geometric and cross-stage violations in four runs that end with DONE (Table D.3 ). The checks use the delivered artifacts even when agent-written reports claim that the requirements have been met.
blocks.zh: 独立检查在与DONE的4个环节中查明几何和跨阶段的违规行为(表D.3)。 检查使用交付的文物,即使代理人书面报告声称满足了要求。

blocks.en: Table D.3: Verified violations after declared completion. Each run ends with DONE but receives zero credit because the submitted artifact violates a task requirement.
blocks.zh: 表D.3:在宣布完成之后核实的违反行为。 每次运行都以DONE结束,但因提交的文物违反了任务要求而获得零信用.

blocks.en: Two of the four listed runs declare DONE ; the remaining runs reach the 300-turn limit or declare FAIL . All four receive zero scores, with distinct discrepancies in the recorded operations and artifacts (Figure D.3 ).
blocks.zh: 列出的4项运行中,有2项宣布完成;其余运行达到300个运行限值或宣布完成。 所有四个都得到零分,在记录的操作和文物中存在明显差异(图D.3).

blocks.en: In the SolidWorks–Abaqus case, the analysis completes and produces an ODB, but the native model uses a − 11.111 -11.111 MPa pressure load. On the specified 30 × 3 30\times 3 mm end face, this pressure corresponds to approximately 1 kN of tension. The evaluator checks native force or displacement parameters without converting pressure to resultant force, so this representation does not satisfy its load check.
blocks.zh: 在SolidWorks–Abaqus案中,分析完成并生成一个ODB,但原产地模型使用−11.11-11.111 MPa压力负载. 在指定的30×3 30\times 3mm端面上,这种压力相当于约1kN的张力. 评估人员在不将压力转换为相应力的情况下检查本土力或迁移参数,因此这种表示不能满足其负载检查.

blocks.en: In the AutoCAD–SolidWorks–Abaqus case, an import-scale error becomes visible during extrusion. The agent corrects the units, but the error reappears after a crash and another DXF import. The transferred model is elongated and lacks the proportions of the 80 × 60 × 21 80\times 60\times 21 mm, ten-fin reference. Repeated volume-meshing attempts continue until the 300-turn limit without producing a solved thermal ODB.
blocks.zh: 在 AutoCAD - SolidWorks - Abaqus 案中,在挤压过程中可以发现导入级错误。 代理更正了单元,但错误在崩溃和另一个 DXF 导入后再次出现. 转移型号的长度为80×60×21 80\time 60\time 21 mm,10-fin引用比例缺失. 重复的量测量尝试一直持续到300转弯极限,而不产生解热的ODB.

blocks.en: The LibreCAD–FreeCAD–KiCad–Blender case stalls during drawing preparation. An intended text edit sends Ctrl+A and Delete to the drawing canvas, clearing the drawing. After the seed drawing is reopened, the saved DXF still contains the diagonal GUIDE lines and lacks the eight required windows. Subsequent attempts to launch FreeCAD do not advance the workflow, which ends with FAIL .
blocks.zh: LibreCAD - FreeCAD - Kicad - Blender 拖曳时的拖曳。 想要编辑的文本发送 Ctrl+A 并删除到绘图布局,清除绘图 。 种子图纸重新打开后,保存的DXF仍然包含对角的GUIDE线条,并缺少所需的8个窗口. 随后推出FreeCAD的尝试并没有推进工作流程,该工作流程以FAIL 结尾.

blocks.en: The KiCad–OpenSCAD–FreeCAD–Blender CLI case produces all 18 required files, including a final Blender render, and ends with DONE . Its mechanical CSV stores mounting-hole diameters under hole_dia_mm , whereas the GT uses hole_diameter_mm . The submitted field name is not among the evaluator’s accepted aliases. The evaluator therefore reads the diameter of MH1 as None and stops before the downstream geometry checks.
blocks.zh: 基卡德- 开放- 自由- 开阔 CLI案产生所有18个所需文件,包括最后的Blender渲染,并以DONE结束。 其机械式CSV在孔下存储嵌入孔直径_dia_mm,而GT则使用孔_直径_mm. 提交的字段名称不属于评估者公认的别名。 因此,评估人员将MH1的直径读作无,并在下游几何检查前停止。
